title: PVS single-variable search acceleration prototype + D2 feasibility
written_before: the performance lane (pvs_perf.test.mts) was executed; the correctness lane was already running
why_this_note_exists: The GO threshold must be fixed BEFORE the numbers are seen, so that a disappointing result cannot be reinterpreted as a near miss, and a lucky root cannot be promoted to the headline.

source_baseline.head: 9ba04b53ff89370a3de6b7c1e318cb78e3c742b1
source_baseline.note: the object under test is the WORKING TREE, not HEAD

frozen_by_this_round.tt_policy: EXACT-only store, exact depth+extensions match, fresh table per search

arms.A_FORK: PPC-SEARCH-01/proto/expectiminimaxPvs.ts with PVS_ENABLED=false — fork control, must be bit-identical to A
arms.B: same fork, PVS_ENABLED=true — THE pre-registered arm; the only algorithmic variable is PVS
arms.C: same fork, PVS_ENABLED=true + PVS_CHANCE_EXEMPT=true — SECONDARY mechanism, reported separately
arms.rule_about_C: Arm C may not be used to convert a failing arm B into a GO. If B fails the gate, the verdict is NO_GO_PVS regardless of what C does; C exists only to explain WHY, and to tell a future round which form of PVS (if any) is worth revisiting.

roots.development_set: the 25 frozen G0.4F-2B-1.9D corpus roots (G1T1-G1T10, G4T1-G4T5, G8T1-G8T10), restored from the human game logs
controls: C_TRAP — trap armed adjacent to the mouse
C_TRAP_RECLAIM — cat standing on its own trap (0-cost reclaim)
C_NO_LEGAL — cat walled in; RULE-A settles the loss inside the transition
C_GHOST — one pending ghost spawn at the cat->mouse boundary
C_BUTTER_PICKUP — mouse beside butter, the pickup opens a CHANCE node
C_PUSH — box pushable from the cat cell
roots.unseen_validation_set: none this round — declared as a known limitation, not silently omitted

correctness_gates.T1_fork_control: arm A_FORK equals arm A on value/mate/completed/bestAction/plan AND on node count, 25 roots x D1/D2
correctness_gates.T2_pvs_parity: arm B equals arm A on value (exact float), mate, completed, bestAction, catTurnPlan, 25 roots x D1/D2
correctness_gates.T2b_armC_parity: arm C equals arm A on the same fields
correctness_gates.T3_tt_soundness: for arms B and C, TT ON equals TT OFF (the EXACT-only store must not have admitted a bound)
correctness_gates.T4_controls_parity: arms B and C equal arm A on all 9 ruleset-v2 controls at D1/D2
correctness_gates.T5_plan_replay: every arm-B cat turn plan re-executes through the real engine transitions
correctness_gates.T6_chance_full_window: chanceNodes === fullWindowChanceSearches for every arm (no chance node was window-pruned)
correctness_gates.fail_rule: any false mate, illegal action, wrong probability mass, wrong TT EXACT entry or leaked incomplete result is an immediate FAIL — 'the move choice looks about the same' is NOT a pass

performance_gates.primary_value_gate: median over the 25 development roots of (D2 wall of A / D2 wall of B) >= 1.25
secondary_gates: D1 completion inside 100 ms must not degrade
no new fallback (empty plan) rows at 100 ms
no material memory regression (TT entries / RSS)
no production budget was increased to obtain the result
reporting_rules: every root is reported; no best-root headline, no mean-of-best
node counts and wall time are reported separately — more nodes is not a speedup
wall time is the median of 3 fresh fixed-depth repetitions and 5 fresh 100 ms repetitions
the deadline lane is directional evidence on a laptop, not a hardware benchmark
performance_gates.no_go_rule: if the primary gate fails, the verdict is NO_GO_PVS. Aspiration windows, LMR, cross-turn TT or new tactical certificates MUST NOT be stacked on to rescue this round.

declared_limitations: the 100 ms / 150 ms lanes are single-process wall-clock measurements on a shared machine
the sidecar and progress guard run AFTER the main search and are out of scope: this round measures the MAIN search only
arm C is a mechanism study, not an admissible result
